:::: {.hero-inner}
::: {.hero-text-col}
[animovement]{.hero-eyebrow}

::: {.hero-lead}
An R toolbox for analysing movement across space and time.
:::

Install *animovement* with:

```r
install.packages(
  "animovement",
  repos = c(
    "https://animovement.r-universe.dev",
    "https://cloud.r-project.org"
  )
)
```
:::
::::
:::::

::: {.landing-section}

## A modular workflow for movement analysis

A collection of R packages for every stage of movement analysis, for
ethologists, behavioural ecologists, neuroscientists, biomechanists, sports
scientists, and anyone else who needs to make sense of how animals move.

::: {.feature-grid}
::: {.feature}
[]{.feature-icon .bi .bi-database}

### Read from anywhere

Support for video-based tracking tools such as *DeepLabCut*, *SLEAP* and
*idtracker.ai*, plus hardware-based data from trackballs.

[VERSATILE]{.feature-pill}
:::

::: {.feature}
[]{.feature-icon .bi .bi-arrow-repeat}

### Flexible toolkit

A *tidyverse*-friendly suite of modular packages that form one unified
workflow. Start with the piece you need, add others as challenges arise.

[MODULAR]{.feature-pill}
:::

::: {.feature}
[]{.feature-icon .bi .bi-shield-check}

### Thoroughly tested

Every package uses *testthat* and *codecov* so the code is thoroughly tested
and you can trust your findings.

[TRUSTED]{.feature-pill}
:::
:::

:::
